title: Economic and Social Dynamics in the Digital Age: An Integrative Framework for Organizational Transformation

detail.title: Economic and Social Dynamics in the Digital Age: An Integrative Framework for Organizational Transformation
detail.abstract: This study presents an integrative theoretical framework for understanding how economic principles and social dynamics interact in the context of digital transformation. Through mixed-methods research involving quantitative survey data (n=412), semi-structured interviews (n=78), and longitudinal case studies of 27 organizations across industries (2019-2023), I identify three distinct manifestations of digital transformation-platformization, intelligent automation, and digital network mobilization-each creating unique patterns of economic-social interaction. The findings reveal that organizations successfully navigating this terrain employ context-specific strategies that recognize the bidirectional influence between economic decisions and social outcomes. Statistical analysis demonstrates significant correlations between integrated economic-social approaches and positive organizational outcomes (r=0.67, p<0.001), with contextual factors moderating these relationships. This research contributes to theory by demonstrating how digital affordances reconfigure traditional economic-social boundaries while extending sociotechnical systems theory to address the specific mechanisms through which digital technologies reshape organizational dynamics. The integrated framework moves beyond techno-deterministic perspectives to establish an empirically grounded understanding of how digital technologies impact both economic value creation and social outcomes, with significant implications for developing digital strategies that balance innovation, equity, and sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个整合性理论框架，探讨数字转型背景下经济原则与社会动态的相互作用。通过混合方法研究发现三种数字转型表现形式（平台化、智能自动化、数字网络动员），揭示了经济决策与社会结果的双向影响关系，并证明整合性经济-社会方法与积极组织成果显著相关。
AI.research_question: 数字转型背景下，经济原则与社会动态如何相互作用？组织如何通过特定策略成功应对这种相互作用？
AI.motivation: 传统研究往往将经济与社会因素分开考虑，缺乏对数字转型中两者相互作用的整合理解。需要超越技术决定论视角，建立实证基础的理论框架来解释数字技术如何重塑组织动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合经济原则与社会动态的理论框架，扩展社会技术系统理论，强调数字可供性如何重构传统经济-社会边界。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定量调查（n=412）、半结构化访谈（n=78）、跨行业27个组织的纵向案例研究（2019-2023）。
AI.findings: 识别三种数字转型表现形式：平台化、智能自动化、数字网络动员；发现整合性经济-社会方法与积极组织成果显著相关（r=0.67, p<0.001）；情境因素调节这些关系；成功组织采用情境特定策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展社会技术系统理论，阐明数字技术重塑组织动态的具体机制；展示数字可供性如何重构传统经济-社会边界；超越技术决定论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定平衡创新、公平和可持续性的数字战略提供指导；帮助组织识别情境特定策略；促进经济价值创造与社会结果的协调发展。

detail.abstract: This study explores relationships between annual advertising expenditure and major macroeconomic variables in Nigeria. Advertising is sometimes viewed as a concern of business units only not worth being researched at macroeconomic level. This nature has been mostly studied on advertising industries in the advanced economies. Due to a lack of high frequency time series data on advertising expenditure in the developing economies, this work has been limited to an exploratory study using the multiple regression and correlation analysis. The study covers the period of 2001 to 2018. Its findings show that advertising has positive relationship with GDP and savings. This study provides further evidence on the cyclical nature of advertising that moves with the state of the economy. During the economic slowdown in the period of 2015 to 2017, Nigeria advertising expenditure continued to fall. In 2013, the period with the highest advertising revenue in the study, the ratio of advertising expenditure as percentage of GDP accounted for 0.061%, which was below 0.2%, a very negligible number indicating more scope for growth in the market.

publicationDetails.detailsText: National Technical Paper Presentation for Undergraduate Students on the topic “Sustainable Development: Impact of Industrialization and Technological Advancement on our Environment and Solutions for a Greener Future.” 2025

detail.abstract: Carbon credit trading is an important method to connect climate action and economic progress. Here, we look at how carbon credit systems work, focusing on their links with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) measures in developing countries. Drawing from policy documents, real world programs, and market data, we explore how these markets function and what makes them effective. The paper outlines the chances carbon credits give to shrink greenhouse gas emissions, encourage investment in green technology, and support global climate aims. Even so, challenges remain, like inconsistent regulations, sharp price changes, tough verification steps, and doubts about whether projects deliver extra environmental benefits. We find that good results need clear rules, trustworthy data checks, and strong involvement of local groups. When run well, carbon credits can help countries grow sustainably while cutting emissions.

title: Paradigm Shift in the African Standby Force Architecture towards a Supranational Effective Peacebuilding System for African States
affiliations: University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria and African Union Commission

detail.title: Paradigm Shift in the African Standby Force Architecture towards a Supranational Effective Peacebuilding System for African States
detail.abstract: Protracted conflict and terrorism threaten African development, peace, and security. The current state security architecture is insufficient to address growing insecurity, prompting calls for a supranational defence force. The African Union's Peace and Security Council (AUPSC) was created to prevent conflicts, support peacekeeping, and respond to grave human rights violations under the African Peace and Security Architecture (APSA). Central to this framework is the African Standby Force (ASF), envisioned in 2004 as a rapid response mechanism drawing military, police, and civilian components from Africa's five regions. Despite plans for full operational readiness by 2015, the ASF remained largely non-functional by 2021, even as violent conflicts intensified across the continent. This study examines the institutional and operational challenges hindering ASF effectiveness. Through a desktop review of APSA policies, intervention experiences, and expert assessments-using case studies from The Gambia, Mali, the Sahel, Sudan, and the Lake Chad Basin-the paper evaluates the contributions of APSA's key pillars, including the PSC, ASF, Panel of the Wise, the Continental Early Warning System, and the "Silence the Guns" initiative. The findings show that while APSA provides a sound framework for coordinated security responses, the ASF continues to lag in readiness, funding, and deployment capacity. The study recommends strengthening APSA's institutional capabilities and resources to enhance Africa's autonomous crisis response, reduce reliance on external actors, and improve the AU's overall effectiveness in managing emerging security threats

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了非洲待命部队（ASF）在非洲和平与安全架构（APSA）中的运作挑战，发现尽管APSA提供了良好的协调框架，但ASF在准备状态、资金和部署能力方面仍然滞后，建议加强机构能力和资源以提升非洲自主危机应对能力。
AI.research_question: 非洲待命部队（ASF）面临哪些制度和运作挑战，阻碍其在非洲和平与安全架构（APSA）中的有效性？
AI.motivation: 长期冲突和恐怖主义威胁非洲的发展、和平与安全，现有国家安全架构不足以应对日益增长的不安全状况，需要建立超国家防御力量。尽管非洲待命部队在2004年构想为快速反应机制，但到2021年仍基本无法运作，而暴力冲突却在加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲和平与安全架构（APSA）理论框架，包括和平与安全理事会（PSC）、非洲待命部队（ASF）、智者小组、大陆预警系统和"让枪声沉默"倡议等关键支柱。
AI.method: 通过桌面审查APSA政策、干预经验和专家评估，使用冈比亚、马里、萨赫勒地区、苏丹和乍得湖盆地的案例研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现，虽然APSA为协调安全响应提供了良好的框架，但ASF在准备状态、资金和部署能力方面仍然滞后。APSA的关键支柱在应对安全挑战方面存在不同程度的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 对非洲和平与安全架构（APSA）理论框架的实证评估，揭示了超国家安全机制在实践中的制度约束和运作障碍，丰富了区域安全治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强APSA的机构能力和资源，以增强非洲自主危机应对能力，减少对外部行为体的依赖，提高非盟在管理新兴安全威胁方面的整体有效性。

reference: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 828
title: Nurturing Nutrition: Evidence from a Randomized Trial of Structured Electronic Food Vouchers in the Philippines
affiliations: Asian Development Bank, Agence Française de Développement (AFD), Asian Development Bank, Agence Française de Développement (AFD), Asian Development Bank and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Nurturing Nutrition: Evidence from a Randomized Trial of Structured Electronic Food Vouchers in the Philippines

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 828
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We present the findings of a pilot that randomized provision of structured electronic food vouchers to poor households in the Philippines, which was designed to inform a new national food voucher program. The study utilized a matched pair cluster-randomized controlled trial to evaluate the effectiveness of vouchers plus nutrition education sessions. It involved 4,883 poor households across five provinces, randomly assigned to the control group or to receive nutrition education and monthly electronic food vouchers worth PHP3,000 ($55) with pre-allocated shares for different food groups. After 6 months, statistically significant improvements are found in household food expenditure, dietary diversity, and food security, although the dietary and food security effects are modest on average. Food expenditure responses to voucher allocations are strongest for proteins and for fruits and vegetables, whereas the carbohydrate allocations are more fungible. Notably, dietary effects are more pronounced in highly urban areas, in households enrolled in an existing conditional cash transfer program, in those with better nutrition knowledge at baseline, in smaller-sized households, and in those that had more recently redeemed the voucher. This suggests that effectiveness could be enhanced by adjusting voucher allocation ratios towards underconsumed food groups, increasing the voucher amount, increasing redemption frequency, and improving nutrition education.

AI.tldr: 在菲律宾进行的试点研究发现，向贫困家庭提供结构化电子食品券（每月3000比索）加上营养教育，能显著改善家庭食品支出、膳食多样性和食品安全，但膳食和食品安全效果平均而言较为温和。效果在高度城市化地区、参与现有有条件现金转移计划的家庭、基线营养知识较好的家庭、小型家庭以及最近兑换券的家庭中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 结构化电子食品券加上营养教育对贫困家庭的食品支出、膳食多样性和食品安全有何影响？哪些因素会调节这种干预的效果？
AI.motivation: 为菲律宾新的国家食品券计划提供实证依据，评估结构化食品券（按食品类别预先分配份额）与营养教育相结合的有效性，以改善贫困家庭的营养状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和营养干预理论，探讨结构化激励（预先分配食品类别份额）如何影响家庭食品消费决策，以及营养知识如何调节干预效果。
AI.method: 匹配对群组随机对照试验，涉及5个省份的4,883户贫困家庭，随机分配到对照组或干预组（营养教育+每月3000比索电子食品券，按食品类别预先分配份额），干预持续6个月。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭食品支出、膳食多样性和食品安全均有统计学显著改善，但膳食和食品安全效果平均较为温和；2. 食品支出反应最强的是蛋白质、水果和蔬菜，碳水化合物分配更具替代性；3. 效果在高度城市化地区、参与有条件现金转移计划的家庭、基线营养知识较好的家庭、小型家庭和最近兑换券的家庭中更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了结构化食品券（按类别分配）相对于无限制现金转移在促进特定营养食品消费方面的有效性；2. 识别了干预效果的关键调节因素（城市化程度、现有社会项目参与、营养知识等）；3. 为"针对性营养干预"理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为菲律宾国家食品券计划提供了具体设计建议：调整券分配比例偏向消费不足的食品类别、增加券金额、提高兑换频率、改进营养教育；2. 识别了最可能受益的目标群体特征；3. 提供了可推广到其他发展中国家的食品券干预模式。

title: Business Cycles and Factor Returns
affiliations: Hokkaido University

detail.title: Business Cycles and Factor Returns
detail.abstract: This study explores the phases of business cycles during periods of increasing factor returns. We employ 195 factor returns and recursively estimate the output gap to identify business cycle phases. We find that approximately 40% of momentum and 20% of profitability factor groups generate statistically significant returns during positive output gap periods, even after adjusting for the multiple hypothesis testing problem. However, the value, investment, intangible, and trading friction factor groups do not demonstrate a clear pattern. Moreover, most factors in these four groups become insignificant once the adjustment is made.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了要素回报增加时期的商业周期阶段。使用195个要素回报并递归估计产出缺口来识别商业周期阶段。研究发现，约40%的动量因子和20%的盈利能力因子在正向产出缺口期间产生统计显著的回报，即使经过多重假设检验调整后。然而，价值、投资、无形资产和交易摩擦因子组没有显示明显模式，且大多数因子在调整后变得不显著。
AI.research_question: 不同因子（动量、盈利能力、价值、投资、无形资产、交易摩擦）在商业周期不同阶段（特别是正向产出缺口期间）的回报表现如何？
AI.motivation: 理解因子投资策略在不同商业周期阶段的表现差异，特别是要素回报增加时期哪些因子能够持续产生显著回报，这对投资组合管理和风险控制有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商业周期理论（产出缺口作为周期阶段指标）和因子投资理论（动量、价值、盈利能力等因子溢价），研究因子回报与商业周期阶段的关联性。
AI.method: 使用195个因子回报数据，递归估计产出缺口来识别商业周期阶段，采用多重假设检验调整方法（如Bonferroni或FDR）控制假阳性风险。
AI.findings:
1. 动量因子：约40%在正向产出缺口期间产生统计显著回报（调整后仍显著）
2. 盈利能力因子：约20%在正向产出缺口期间产生统计显著回报（调整后仍显著）
3. 价值、投资、无形资产、交易摩擦因子：没有明显模式，大多数在多重检验调整后变得不显著
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了因子回报与商业周期阶段关联性的实证证据
2. 识别了动量因子在扩张期（正向产出缺口）的稳健性
3. 揭示了不同因子对商业周期敏感性的差异
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供商业周期不同阶段的因子配置建议
2. 动量因子在扩张期可作为可靠的投资策略
3. 提醒投资者注意价值、投资等因子在周期中的不稳定性
4. 强调多重检验调整在因子研究中的重要性

title: Inflationary Effects on Consumer Purchase Behavior and Pricing
affiliations: Syracuse University - Whitman School of Management, Arizona State University and

detail.title: Inflationary Effects on Consumer Purchase Behavior and Pricing
detail.abstract: Problem Definition: In developing economies facing high inflation and price volatility, governments often seek to project stability through cautious reporting of inflation rates. As a result, discrepancies emerge between official and independently-assessed figures, creating substantial ambiguity about the true level of inflation. Inflation ambiguity distorts price expectations and leads to deviations between actual and expected prices. These deviations, perceived as gains or losses, elicit behavioral biases that complicate consumers' purchasing decisions and firms' pricing strategies. Methodology/Results: Using sales transaction data from Türkiye's largest kombucha producer, we estimate a structural logit model to analyze consumer behavior under high inflation. Our empirical findings reveal three key insights. First, higher inflation increases purchase likelihood, as consumers accelerate spending to avoid future price hikes. Second, inflation ambiguity, measured as the discrepancy between official and independent rates, decreases purchase probability. The negative influence of ambiguity can be more pronounced than the demand-stimulating effect of high inflation. Third, price gains relative to expectations encourage purchases, while losses suppress them. Consistent with prospect theory, consumers display loss aversion: The impact of price losses consistently outweighs the impact of gains. These results are robust across alternative model specifications. Based on the above findings, we develop an empirically-grounded analytical model to examine the optimal price decision for a firm operating under high inflation and inflation ambiguity. Prior studies model the reference-price effect piecewise linearly in the utility function and suggest that higher values of the reference price lead to an increase in the optimal price. However, our work shows that nonlinear reference-price effects identified in the empirical analysis can reduce the optimal price with increasing values of the reference price. Managerial Implications: These insights underscore the need for transparent and credible inflation communication to sustain consumer confidence and demand stability in inflationary settings. Our study provides evidence that inflation ambiguity negatively impacts consumer spending and consumption. Therefore, policymakers should prioritize reducing inflation ambiguity through greater transparency. Firms should consider not only high inflation but also inflation ambiguity and reference price-dependent consumer behavior when setting prices.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了高通胀和通胀模糊性如何影响消费者购买行为和公司定价策略。基于土耳其最大的康普茶生产商的销售数据，研究发现：高通胀刺激购买（预防性消费），但通胀模糊性（官方与独立通胀率差异）抑制购买；消费者表现出损失厌恶，价格损失的影响大于收益；非线性参考价格效应可能降低最优价格。
AI.research_question: 在高通胀和通胀模糊性环境下，消费者购买行为如何变化？公司应如何制定最优定价策略？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体面临高通胀和价格波动时，政府常谨慎报告通胀率，导致官方与独立数据差异，产生通胀模糊性。这种模糊性扭曲价格预期，导致实际与预期价格偏差，引发行为偏差，影响消费者购买决策和公司定价策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（损失厌恶）、参考价格效应、行为经济学中的认知偏差、通胀预期理论
AI.method: 使用土耳其最大康普茶生产商的销售交易数据，构建结构Logit模型分析消费者行为；开发基于实证的分析模型研究公司最优定价决策
AI.findings: 1. 高通胀增加购买可能性（预防性消费）；2. 通胀模糊性降低购买概率，其负面影响可能超过高通胀的刺激效应；3. 价格收益促进购买，损失抑制购买，消费者表现出损失厌恶；4. 非线性参考价格效应可能导致最优价格随参考价格增加而降低
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将通胀模糊性概念引入消费者行为分析；2. 发现非线性参考价格效应可能逆转传统线性模型的结论；3. 整合通胀环境、行为偏差和定价策略的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应提高通胀透明度以减少模糊性；2. 公司定价时需同时考虑高通胀、通胀模糊性和参考价格依赖的消费者行为；3. 提供实证证据支持透明通胀沟通对维持消费者信心的重要性

title: Does Political Pressure Affect Central Bank Policy?

detail.title: Does Political Pressure Affect Central Bank Policy?
detail.abstract: The independence of central banks (CBI) has been celebrated for decades as a key modern device in managing economic policy. But theory and practice are seldom 100 percent aligned. Politicians, especially in the months leading up to elections or under the cloud of economic downturns, have strong reasons to pressure central banks. This study poses a deceptively straightforward question: just how much does political pressure actually warp monetary policy? The paper taps into the long tradition in economic theory of models of "time inconsistency," dozens of (often) crosscountry empirical studies, and high-frequency studies of U.S. presidential communication. With a wide-ranging literature review, a mathematical model and three instructive case studies, America during 2018-2019, India during those same years, and Turkey from 2021 to 2022, their op-ed is a tapestry of a new theory. To capture political influence, a pressure-adjusted Taylor rule is presented, which yields the ability to measure how policy departs from its rule-based trajectory in response to political forces. The findings are striking. In rich countries, where institutions provide stronger safeguards, political pressure might explain 30% of short-run deviations. The share rises even higher in the case of 2019 in the United States, to 55%, as markets digested repeated criticism from a president. Among politicized regimes like Turkey, that was offset by pressure overwhelming fundamentals entirely, pressure was responsible for as much as 95% of the divergence. Independence, then, operates less as a shield than a sieve: It dulls the pressure, but it does not eliminate it. Maintaining that independence is crucial if central banks are to anchor inflation and preserve their own credibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究政治压力如何扭曲货币政策，通过压力调整的泰勒规则量化政治影响。研究发现，在制度健全的发达国家，政治压力可解释30%的短期政策偏离，而在政治化体制中（如土耳其）这一比例高达95%。
AI.research_question: 政治压力实际上在多大程度上扭曲了货币政策？
AI.motivation: 尽管央行独立性被认为是经济政策管理的关键机制，但理论与实践常存在差距。政治家在选举前或经济衰退期间有强烈动机向央行施压，需要量化这种政治压力对货币政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间不一致性理论模型、压力调整的泰勒规则、央行独立性理论
AI.method: 广泛的文献综述、数学模型、三个案例研究（美国2018-2019年、印度同期、土耳其2021-2022年）、高频美国总统沟通研究
AI.findings:
1. 发达国家（制度保障较强）：政治压力可解释约30%的短期政策偏离
2. 美国2019年：政治压力解释55%的偏离（总统反复批评的影响）
3. 土耳其（政治化体制）：政治压力解释高达95%的政策偏离
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出压力调整的泰勒规则，量化政治压力对货币政策的影响
2. 揭示央行独立性更多是"筛子"而非"盾牌"的作用——减弱压力而非消除压力
3. 为政治压力与货币政策关系提供新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为央行和政策制定者提供量化政治压力影响的工具
2. 强调维护央行独立性对锚定通胀预期和保持信誉的重要性
3. 帮助识别不同制度环境下政治压力的影响程度

reference: SMU Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 714
title: Putting Defense on the Agenda: How Public Defender Offices Reshape Indigent Defense Practice in Texas
affiliations: Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law, Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law and Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law

detail.title: Putting Defense on the Agenda: How Public Defender Offices Reshape Indigent Defense Practice in Texas

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 714
publicationDetails.journalName: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper examines how the creation of public defender offices affects access to court appointed counsel in misdemeanor cases. Focusing on Texas, where 254 counties independently organize indigent defense, it treats public defender offices as organizational interventions within a rationed system shaped by governments, judges, and defense lawyers. Using annual county-level data from 2006-2022, we apply the synthetic control method to compare appointed representation rates in sixteen counties that established public defender offices with weighted combinations of non-adopting counties. We then interpret these patterns using forty-six interviews with local stakeholders in twenty-three counties, including commissioners, judges, and defense providers.

Statistically, we find that public defender office creation is frequently associated with sizable and sometimes statistically significant increases in appointed representation rates, particularly in regional systems serving multiple rural counties. One regional office, however, shows no clear effect, underscoring the importance of local context. Interview data suggest that offices that increased representation most were those that reorganized front-end processes—routinely checking jail rosters, maintaining a regular courtroom presence, and directly assisting defendants with indigency applications. Drawing on neo-institutionalist theory, we argue that these changes reflect both coercive pressures from the state’s funding and oversight agency and emerging professional norms within a growing defender community. The findings highlight public defender offices not as automatic solutions but as organizational platforms that can expand access to counsel when they are structured and staffed to proactively connect defendants with representation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公共辩护人办公室的设立如何影响轻罪案件中指定辩护律师的获取。通过对德克萨斯州16个县的数据分析发现，公共辩护人办公室的设立通常能显著提高指定辩护率，特别是服务于多个农村县的区域性系统。但效果取决于当地背景和组织结构。
AI.research_question: 公共辩护人办公室的设立如何影响轻罪案件中指定辩护律师的获取？
AI.motivation: 在德克萨斯州，254个县各自独立组织贫困辩护服务，公共辩护人办公室作为组织干预措施，旨在改善由政府部门、法官和辩护律师共同塑造的配给制系统中的辩护服务获取。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新制度主义理论，强调国家资助和监督机构的强制性压力，以及不断发展的辩护律师社区中新兴的专业规范。
AI.method: 使用2006-2022年县级年度数据，采用合成控制法比较16个设立公共辩护人办公室的县与未设立县的加权组合；辅以对23个县的46名当地利益相关者（专员、法官、辩护提供者）的访谈。
AI.findings: 公共辩护人办公室的设立通常与指定辩护率的大幅提高相关，特别是在服务于多个农村县的区域性系统中。但有一个区域性办公室未显示明显效果，表明地方背景的重要性。访谈显示，提高辩护率最成功的办公室是那些重组前端流程的机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 运用新制度主义理论解释公共辩护人办公室如何通过强制性压力和新兴专业规范来改善辩护服务获取，丰富了组织干预在司法系统中的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明公共辩护人办公室不是自动解决方案，而是需要适当结构和人员配置的组织平台，应注重前端流程重组（如定期检查监狱名册、保持法庭存在、直接协助贫困申请）来主动连接被告与辩护服务。

title: What Do the Numbers Meme? A Creative Assignment to Encourage Student Engagement and Higher-Order Thinking in Accounting Education
affiliations: , Tilburg University, WU Vienna University of Economics and Business and WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management

detail.title: What Do the Numbers Meme? A Creative Assignment to Encourage Student Engagement and Higher-Order Thinking in Accounting Education
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine the effects of a creative assignment involving the creation of course content-related internet memes on students’ academic performance. The assignment, designed to increase student engagement and stimulate higher-order thinking, requires students to create a meme related to one of the concepts covered in an introductory accounting course. Our findings indicate that participation in the meme assignment enhances students’ academic performance on the final exam, particularly on items requiring higher-order thinking. Furthermore, we find that the meme assignment engages students and increases their active involvement in learning about accounting topics. We also find that the meme assignment is positively related to lecturer evaluations and that lecturers view the assignment as a positive addition to accounting courses. Our findings suggest that integrating meme assignments into accounting courses can enhance student engagement and learning outcomes, providing an impactful yet low-cost tool for accounting educators.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨在会计课程中引入创意作业（制作课程相关网络迷因）对学生学业表现的影响。研究发现该作业能提升学生参与度、高阶思维能力，并改善最终考试成绩。
AI.research_question: 创意迷因作业如何影响会计课程学生的学业表现、参与度和高阶思维能力？
AI.motivation: 寻找低成本但有效的教学工具来提高会计课程的学生参与度和学习效果，特别是促进高阶思维能力的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学生参与度理论、高阶思维培养理论和创新教学方法理论，探讨创意作业如何通过增加学生主动参与来提升学习效果。
AI.method: 在会计导论课程中实施迷因创作作业，要求学生制作与课程概念相关的网络迷因，通过考试成绩、学生参与度测量和教师评价等多维度数据进行分析。
AI.findings:
1. 参与迷因作业显著提升学生期末考试成绩，特别是需要高阶思维的题目
2. 作业增加学生参与度和对会计主题的主动学习
3. 作业与教师评价呈正相关，教师认为这是会计课程的有益补充
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新教学方法理论提供实证支持，验证了创意作业在促进高阶思维和主动学习方面的有效性，丰富了会计教育领域的教学理论。

detail.abstract: Using large-scale high-granularity data from a food delivery platform and granular pollution and weather information, we study how PM2.5 fluctuations affect riders’ absenteeism, productivity, and accidents. Exploiting exogenous pollution variation from inverse boundary layer height, we find that higher pollution increases absenteeism for all workers and raises delivery times and accident rates only among (e-)bike riders, who must exert physical effort while working. Affected workers compensate productivity losses by working longer hours. Monetary incentives mitigate the effects on absenteeism but do not offset the decline in productivity and appear to exacerbate accident risk.Air Pollution; Food Delivery Riders; Absenteeism; Labor Productivity; Workplace Safety

detail.abstract: This chapter explores the intersection of health economics and international relations through the case of Israel's health diplomacy and behavioral health strategies. Focusing on the strategic application of behavioral economics-particularly nudge theory-during the COVID-19 vaccination campaign, the chapter highlights how these tools enhanced public health compliance and bolstered international cooperation. Israel's initiatives in sharing medical resources, conducting collaborative research, and providing training abroad serve as exemplary practices of health diplomacy that strengthened geopolitical influence and regional stability. The narrative critically examines the dual role of health policy as both a soft power instrument and a mechanism for conflict resolution, especially under unstable geopolitical conditions. Drawing from recent scholarship on health governance, behavioral policy, and diplomacy, the chapter argues that health economics can transcend national boundaries, contributing to global peace and security. It concludes with a call to harness health diplomacy in post-conflict settings, proposing it as a catalyst for addressing not only health disparities but also deeper structural causes of conflict through cooperation and mutual benefit. The case of Israel provides a forward-looking framework for integrating health strategies into foreign policy and offers transferable insights for global policy design.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the vulnerability of U.S. hotel revenues to economic crises by focusing on losses in revenue per available room (RevPAR) and GDP per capita (GDPpc). Unlike traditional approaches that rely on partial derivatives of demand (occupancy, OCC) or price (average daily rate, ADR), this research develops two structural equation models (SEM) with crises dummy variables to capture systemic shocks directly. Model 1 emphasizes synthetic and random shocks, while Model 2 redistributes variance across real and synthetic interactions. Results from STR data (1990-2024) reveal that peak periods remain relatively stable, while off-peak months suffer severe declines. A Nash equilibrium framework demonstrates that raising prices in peak seasons and discounting in off-peak seasons is the optimal crisisavoidance strategy. By splitting hypotheses into conceptual (literature-based) and empirical (SEM-supported) tables, this study bridges Nobel-recognized economic theory with applied hospitality management, offering metaphors of shock absorbers and pendulums to clarify resilience strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过结构方程模型分析美国酒店收入在经济危机中的脆弱性，发现旺季相对稳定而淡季严重下滑，并提出旺季提价、淡季打折的最优危机应对策略。
AI.research_question: 美国酒店收入（特别是每间可用客房收入RevPAR）在经济危机中的脆弱性如何？哪些因素影响其波动？最优的危机应对策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖需求（入住率）或价格（平均每日房价）的偏导数分析，无法直接捕捉系统性冲击。需要开发新方法来理解经济危机对酒店收入的直接影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 结构方程模型（SEM）理论；2. 纳什均衡博弈论框架；3. 诺贝尔经济学奖认可的经济理论；4. 冲击吸收器和钟摆隐喻理论
AI.method: 使用两个带危机虚拟变量的结构方程模型：模型1强调合成和随机冲击，模型2重新分配真实和合成交互的方差。分析STR数据（1990-2024年），将假设分为概念性（文献基础）和实证性（SEM支持）表格。

title: FX Market Making with Internal Liquidity
affiliations: HSBC FX eRisk, Global Markets, HSBC Bank Plc., UK, Imperial College London and Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: FX Market Making with Internal Liquidity
detail.abstract: As the FX markets continue to evolve, many institutions have started offering passive access to their internal liquidity pools. Market makers act as principal and have the opportunity to fill those orders as part of their risk management, or they may choose to adjust pricing to their external OTC franchise to facilitate the matching flow. It is, a priori, unclear how the strategies managing internal liquidity should depend on market condions, the market maker's risk appetite, and the placement algorithms deployed by participating clients. The market maker's actions in the presence of passive orders are relevant not only for their own objectives, but also for those liquidity providers who have certain expectations of the execution speed. In this work, we investigate the optimal multi-objective strategy of a market maker with an option to take liquidity on an internal exchange, and draw important qualitative insights for real-world trading.

detail.abstract: Community-scale microgrids are emerging as a key enabler of energy resilience, decarbonization, and inclusive access to electricity in both urban and rural environments. Yet operating these systems reliably under uncertainty-variable renewables, heterogeneous loads, and limited connectivity-remains challenging for human operators alone. This paper proposes a Federated Edge Intelligence framework in which lightweight AI agents deployed at the grid edge collaborate with human stakeholders to manage storage, demand response, and islanding decisions. The framework combines (i) local learning and prediction on edge devices, (ii) federated optimization across multiple microgrids, and (iii) human-in-the-loop decision support * ORCID: 0000-0002-3442-2215. Affiliation: Fourth Industrial Systems Corporation. The author acknowledges conceptual feedback from microgrid engineers, NGO practitioners, and community energy planners who informed the design assumptions in this paper. 1 with explainable recommendations. Designed for low-resource settings with intermittent connectivity, the architecture emphasizes data minimization, robustness, and participatory governance. Using realistic simulations based on open microgrid benchmarks, we show that the proposed approach improves loss-of-load probability by up to 32%, reduces diesel backup usage by 18-27%, and maintains performance under constrained backhaul bandwidth. A small-scale user study with 16 operators and community representatives indicates that explainable edge agents increase perceived trust and willingness to adopt AI assistance. The work illustrates how "AI for All" can be operationalized in critical infrastructure serving vulnerable communities, by combining federated learning, edge intelligence, and human oversight in a single socio-technical design.

title: The Monetarist Paradox: Robust Evidence from Short and Long Term Interest Rates

detail.title: The Monetarist Paradox: Robust Evidence from Short and Long Term Interest Rates
detail.abstract: The monetarist paradox adumbrated by Milton Friedman can be stated as implying that an easy money policy leads (in the long run) to (high) interest rates. This paper works out a numerical simulation of this proposition by embedding the central bank's policy rate in a model that combines the expectations augmented Phillips curve with the Fisher equation for interest rates, but without the Quantity Theory. Using the Alesina-Summers index of central bank independence, it then provides robust evidence cross country evidence that countries with stronger central banks tend to have lower official discount rates and lower market determined long bond yields. It further provides robust time series evidence from the Volcker disinflation, indicating that the high real interest rates of the early 1980s in USA and select European countries was a temporary consequence of tight money, and that the Sargent-Wallace recommendation to monetize the debt was under those circumstances was based on their erroneous long run extrapolation. The implications of the wide ranging evidence presented here for very recent recommendations of US President Trump that the Federal Reserve steeply lower the funds rate to ease America's debt burden are drawn out.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过数值模拟和实证分析验证了弗里德曼的货币主义悖论：宽松货币政策长期会导致高利率。研究发现央行独立性强的国家利率更低，沃尔克紧缩时期的利率是暂时的，并对特朗普降息建议提出警示。

AI.theoretical_framework: 弗里德曼的货币主义悖论、预期增强的菲利普斯曲线、费雪利率方程、Alesina-Summers央行独立性指数。
AI.method: 1. 数值模拟：将央行政策利率嵌入结合预期增强菲利普斯曲线和费雪方程的模型；2. 跨国实证分析：使用Alesina-Summers指数检验央行独立性与利率关系；3. 时间序列分析：研究沃尔克紧缩时期的利率动态。
AI.findings: 1. 央行独立性强的国家官方贴现率和长期债券收益率更低；2. 1980年代初美国和欧洲的高实际利率是紧缩货币政策的暂时结果；3. Sargent-Wallace的债务货币化建议基于错误的长期外推。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为弗里德曼货币主义悖论提供实证支持；2. 澄清了紧缩货币政策与利率关系的动态机制；3. 批判了Sargent-Wallace债务货币化建议的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 支持央行独立性对维持低利率的重要性；2. 对特朗普要求美联储大幅降息以缓解债务负担的建议提出警示；3. 为货币政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Textualism Wins?: The Supreme Court's 2024 Labor & Employment Law Cases
affiliations: William & Mary Law School

detail.title: Textualism Wins?: The Supreme Court's 2024 Labor & Employment Law Cases
detail.abstract: This article discusses six cases from the Supreme Court’s 2024 term, five of them are labor and employment cases. The sixth is the administrative law decision that overruled Chevron deference (Loper Bright). Although that decision is not a labor and employment law decision, it will likely have a significant impact on labor and employment law. Although the labor and employment cases had surprising unanimity, and three of them had pro-plaintiff results, both of those results might be explained by the fact that, for most of the cases, textualism carried the day. Although textualism helped achieve mostly pro-plaintiff results this year, it might not in future years. And the one non-labor and employment case (Loper Bright) might end up eclipsing all the good that came out of this term.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国最高法院2024年度的六个案例，其中五个是劳动就业法案件，一个是推翻Chevron尊重的行政法案件。虽然劳动就业案件显示出惊人的一致性和三个有利于原告的结果，但这主要归因于文本主义的应用。然而，文本主义未来可能不会继续产生有利于原告的结果，而推翻Chevron尊重的Loper Bright案可能对劳动就业法产生深远负面影响。
AI.research_question: 美国最高法院2024年度劳动就业法案件的判决趋势和影响因素是什么？这些判决对未来劳动就业法的发展有何启示？
AI.motivation: 分析最高法院2024年度劳动就业法案件的判决模式，探讨文本主义在司法决策中的作用，评估推翻Chevron尊重的行政法案件对劳动就业法的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本主义司法理论、Chevron尊重原则、司法决策理论、劳动就业法理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，对最高法院2024年度的六个相关案件进行深入分析，包括五个劳动就业法案件和一个行政法案件，重点关注判决模式、司法推理和法律影响。
AI.findings: 1. 五个劳动就业法案件显示出惊人的司法一致性；2. 三个案件产生了有利于原告的结果；3. 这些结果主要归因于文本主义司法方法的运用；4. 文本主义在当前案件中有利于原告，但未来可能产生不同结果；5. Loper Bright案推翻Chevron尊重可能对劳动就业法产生深远负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了文本主义在劳动就业法案件中的具体应用和影响；2. 分析了司法方法论与案件结果之间的关系；3. 探讨了行政法原则变化对专门法领域的溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为劳动法律师提供了最高法院当前司法倾向的洞察；2. 警示了文本主义方法可能带来的不确定性；3. 强调了Loper Bright案对劳动就业法实践的重要影响；4. 为未来诉讼策略提供了参考依据。

title: Social Networks in Motion: High-Speed Rail and Market Reactions to Earnings News
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University - School of Economics & Management, College of Business, Stony Brook University and

detail.title: Social Networks in Motion: High-Speed Rail and Market Reactions to Earnings News
detail.abstract: We examine how social networks shaped by high-speed rail connections influence investor attention and market reactions to earnings announcements in China. Firms in high-centrality cities exhibit stronger immediate and subsequent responses in investor attention, stock price, and trading volume to earnings news. Further analysis shows that earnings-induced local attention predicts future attention spillovers to intercity investors, amplifying both price and volume reactions after announcements. Overall, these findings indicate that high-speed rail networks foster investor social networks that facilitate the dissemination of firm news and help explain predictable patterns in investor behavior and market pricing.

AI.tldr: 高铁网络塑造的社会网络影响中国投资者对财报公告的关注度和市场反应。位于高中心性城市的公司对财报新闻表现出更强的投资者关注、股价和交易量反应。财报引发的本地关注能预测未来跨城市投资者的关注溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 高铁网络塑造的社会网络如何影响投资者对财报公告的关注度和市场反应？
AI.motivation: 研究高铁网络如何通过塑造投资者社会网络来影响信息传播和市场效率，解释投资者行为和市场定价的可预测模式。

AI.method: 基于中国高铁网络数据，分析城市中心性对投资者关注和市场反应的影响，检验本地关注对跨城市投资者关注的预测作用。

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高铁网络通过塑造社会网络影响信息传播的机制，扩展了投资者关注和社会网络理论在金融市场中的应用。

AI.method: 实证分析，可能使用计量经济学方法（如双重差分法）分析地震前后的经济增长数据，并评估援助资金的影响。

detail.title: 홍해 위기가 우리 경제에 미친 영향과 물류 회랑 다변화에의 시사점(The Impact of the Red Sea Crisis on Korea’s Trade and Its Implications for Diversifying Logistics Corridors)

keywords: Geopolitical Risk in Global Supply Chains

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In December 2023, the Houthi rebels in Yemen launched attacks on commercial vessels in the Red Sea, escalating the Israel-Hamas conflict into a broader geopolitical risk encompassing the Red Sea region. This development disrupted the logistics supply chain between Asia and Europe, which had previously relied heavily on the Suez Canal. As maritime routes shifted from the Suez Canal to the Cape of Good Hope, countries worldwide, including South Korea, faced increased shipping and insurance costs. This situation posed the dual challenges of weakened export competitiveness and rising inflation.Simultaneously, the Red Sea crisis underscored the need for alternative land and maritime logistics networks to ensure supply chain stability. This led to heightened international interest in establishing new logistics hubs. Notably, discussions surrounding the Indo-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), announced at the 2023 G20 Summit, and the Development Road project, actively promoted by Turkiye and Iraq, gained traction following the Red Sea crisis. (The rest omitted.)

title: CROWDED AND CONCENTRATED? A DENSITY PARADOX IN NONPROFIT MARKETS
affiliations: Samford University - Brock School of Business and Arizona State University (ASU) - School of Public Affairs

detail.title: CROWDED AND CONCENTRATED? A DENSITY PARADOX IN NONPROFIT MARKETS
detail.abstract: We present a paradox where nonprofit markets appear crowded by organizational counts yet exhibit oligopolistic resource control. We analyze 4.7 million organization-years from IRS Form 990 filings across 938 U.S. metropolitan areas from 2012 to 2021. Classical density measures from population ecology and industrial organization correlate weakly with revenue concentration. We test a multi-sided platform framework where nonprofits intermediate between private donors, government funders, and clients. Platform coupling measures demonstrate that the same organizations often dominate multiple constituencies. We document bimodal concentration distributions, a hallmark of platform markets where few organizations dominate resource pools. Client-side concentration deters market entry while private-side concentration encourages it. Paradoxically, concentration on any side does not result in resource extraction, while multi-sided nonprofits capture extraordinary revenue premiums. Coordination creates competitive advantag es through diversification rather than domination. Platform dynamics prevail without platform power.

AI.tldr: 非营利市场呈现组织数量众多但资源控制寡头化的悖论。研究发现，传统密度指标与收入集中度相关性弱，而多边平台框架能更好解释这一现象：少数组织通过协调多方利益相关者（私人捐赠者、政府资助者、客户）获得竞争优势和收入溢价。
AI.research_question: 非营利市场为何呈现组织数量众多（看似拥挤）但资源控制高度集中（寡头化）的悖论？多边平台框架如何解释这种市场结构？
AI.motivation: 传统的人口生态学和产业组织理论无法充分解释非营利市场的独特结构：组织数量众多但资源高度集中。需要新的理论框架来理解非营利组织如何协调多方利益相关者并形成竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边平台理论（multi-sided platform framework），将非营利组织视为连接私人捐赠者、政府资助者和客户的中介平台。平台耦合度、资源集中度等概念。
AI.method: 分析2012-2021年美国938个大都市区的470万组织年数据（来自IRS 990表格）。使用传统密度指标与平台耦合度测量，检验收入集中度分布模式。
AI.findings: 1. 传统密度指标与收入集中度相关性弱；2. 发现双峰集中度分布，符合平台市场特征；3. 客户侧集中度抑制市场进入，私人捐赠侧集中度促进进入；4. 任何单侧集中都不会导致资源榨取，但多边协调的非营利组织能获得超额收入溢价；5. 竞争优势来自多元化而非支配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将多边平台理论应用于非营利部门，解释市场结构悖论；2. 提出"平台动态主导但无平台权力"的新见解；3. 揭示非营利组织通过协调而非支配获得竞争优势的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非营利组织管理者提供战略指导：通过有效协调多方利益相关者获得竞争优势；2. 为政策制定者提供监管参考：理解非营利市场集中度的复杂影响；3. 为捐赠者和投资者提供决策依据。

AI.tldr: 本研究全面分析中国先进半导体创新能力，聚焦政策支持体系、高带宽内存（HBM）和第三代半导体，并为韩国提出应对策略。
AI.research_question: 中国的先进半导体创新能力现状如何？特别是在政策支持体系、高带宽内存（HBM）和第三代半导体领域的发展情况？韩国应如何应对中国的半导体技术进步？
AI.motivation: 随着中国在半导体领域的快速发展和政策支持，对全球半导体产业格局产生影响，特别是对韩国这样的半导体强国构成竞争压力，需要系统分析中国的创新能力和制定应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新系统理论、国家创新体系理论、技术追赶理论、产业政策分析框架

detail.abstract: In the 2020s, the Korean and Japanese governments faced a cri- sis involving supply chain disruptions of critical mineral resources alongside the reorganization of global supply chains due to efforts to promote digital transformation (DX) and green transformation (GX) within their domestic industrial bases. To address these is- sues, both the Korean and Japanese governments have con  centrated their policy capabilities on stabilizing the supply chain for critical minerals through various strategies, policies, and legis- lation related to critical minerals. The Korean government began designating the five EV battery metals and rare earths as critical minerals through the Critical Minerals Securing Strategy in February 2023, and enacted the National Resources Security Special Act in February 2024. Japan also enacted the Economic Security Promotion Act in May 2022, somewhat earlier than Korea, and designated critical minerals as “particularly important materi- als” in December 2022. By March 2024, Japan further added gal- ium, germanium, and uranium to its list of particularly important materials as a response to China's rate metal  export controls. (The rest omitted.)

title: Climate Change Increases Bilateral Trade Costs

detail.title: Climate Change Increases Bilateral Trade Costs

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: It is well established that climate change affects productivity, but its effects on trade costs have not been studied. I combine international trade and weather data covering 190 years. I use an augmented gravity framework to show that rising temperatures at the origin or destination country increase bilateral trade costs. Adaptation to these impacts is slow. The impact appears to be driven by the vulnerability of sea ports to climate change. Combining these results with a standard international trade model, I find that 2010s welfare would increase by 1.6 percent if we could undo the impact of climate change on trade cost over the preceding 100 years. Welfare gains depend not only on countries' own climate trends, but also on their neighbors' trajectories. Poor and rich countries are roughly equally harmed. Smaller economies, which are more reliant on international trade, are especially affected. Ignoring this trade cost channel and focusing only on productivity effects leads to a nine percent underestimate of the welfare impact of climate change. Because it is based on a gravity framework, my methodology can easily be embedded in studies of the impact of climate change.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次量化了气候变化对贸易成本的影响，发现温度上升会增加双边贸易成本，主要机制是海港对气候变化的脆弱性。如果消除过去100年气候变化对贸易成本的影响，2010年代全球福利将增加1.6%。忽略这一贸易成本渠道会低估气候变化福利影响的9%。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何影响国际贸易成本？这种影响对全球福利的后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 虽然气候变化对生产率的影响已有研究，但其对贸易成本的影响尚未被探讨。贸易成本是国际贸易的关键决定因素，理解这一渠道对于全面评估气候变化的经济影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于扩展的重力模型框架，结合标准国际贸易理论，分析气候变化如何通过影响贸易成本进而影响福利。
AI.method: 结合190年的国际贸易和天气数据，使用扩展的重力模型框架量化气候变化对双边贸易成本的影响，并将结果嵌入标准国际贸易模型进行福利分析。
AI.findings: 1. 原产国或目的国温度上升会增加双边贸易成本；2. 适应这些影响的过程缓慢；3. 主要机制是海港对气候变化的脆弱性；4. 消除过去100年气候变化对贸易成本的影响可使2010年代福利增加1.6%；5. 福利收益不仅取决于本国气候趋势，还受邻国轨迹影响；6. 贫富国家受损程度大致相当；7. 更依赖国际贸易的小型经济体受影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将气候变化与贸易成本联系起来，扩展了气候变化经济影响的理论框架，提供了量化这一新渠道的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示气候变化通过贸易成本渠道对全球福利的显著影响；2. 提供可嵌入其他气候变化研究的方法论；3. 为政策制定者提供更全面的气候变化经济影响评估；4. 强调海港基础设施适应气候变化的重要性。

title: Data Nonrivalry, Privacy Concerns, and Market Efficiency *
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Tohoku University and

detail.title: Data Nonrivalry, Privacy Concerns, and Market Efficiency *
detail.abstract: This paper develops a tractable general-equilibrium model of digital markets in which firms use data as a nonrival input and consumers exhibit privacy concerns. We characterize equilibrium and the social optimum and show that their divergence arises from the interaction of data nonrivalry and privacy-driven non-homothetic demand. In particular, we identify a new data-cost-reduction effect that contributes to these distortions. Furthermore, by examining the effects of market expansion, we find that data nonrivalry emerges as a new source of welfare gains, whereas privacy concerns play a relatively minor role.

title: Avoiding Prejudice: Islamophobia and the Labor Supply of Arabs and Muslims in the U.S
affiliations: Yale School of Management, University of Rochester, University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Economics, Charles III University of Madrid and Government of the United States of America - U.S. Air Force Academy

detail.title: Avoiding Prejudice: Islamophobia and the Labor Supply of Arabs and Muslims in the U.S

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper provides direct evidence that members of a disfavored group adjust their economic behavior in response to prejudice. We exploit plausibly exogenous, localized increases in anti-Arab and anti-Muslim sentiment generated by combat fatalities of U.S. service members from a given state during the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan between 2001 and 2014. Linking detailed records on military fatalities with survey data, we estimate the causal effect of these shocks on the labor supply of Arab and Muslim men residing in the affected states. Following a home-state fatality, Arab and Muslim men reduce their weekly hours of work by approximately one percent relative to the baseline sample mean. The reduction is twice as large among the self-employed and concentrated in occupations requiring frequent customer or co-worker interaction. These patterns are consistent with avoidance-based sorting predicted by prejudice-based models of discrimination. The timing of the response coincides with short-lived increases in anti-Muslim hate crimes, confirming that the estimated effects reflect shifts in prejudice rather than broader economic conditions. Our findings provide direct evidence that prejudice can distort market outcomes by inducing targeted individuals to withdraw from interactions with prejudiced market participants.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用美军在伊拉克和阿富汗战争中各州士兵阵亡事件作为外生冲击，发现阿拉伯和穆斯林男性在所在州发生阵亡事件后，每周工作时间减少约1%，自雇者减少幅度加倍，且集中在需要频繁客户或同事互动的职业，表明偏见导致受歧视群体通过减少工作参与来避免与偏见者互动。
AI.research_question: 偏见如何影响受歧视群体的经济行为？具体来说，反阿拉伯和反穆斯林情绪的外生冲击如何影响阿拉伯和穆斯林男性的劳动供给？
AI.motivation: 虽然偏见和歧视对市场结果的影响已有广泛研究，但关于受歧视群体如何调整自身经济行为以应对偏见的直接证据相对缺乏。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究偏见是否会导致受歧视群体通过减少劳动参与来避免与偏见者互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于偏见的歧视理论，特别是回避型分类模型。该理论预测受歧视群体会通过减少与偏见者的互动来避免歧视，从而导致市场扭曲。
AI.method: 利用2001-2014年伊拉克和阿富汗战争中各州美军士兵阵亡事件作为外生冲击，引发当地反阿拉伯和反穆斯林情绪。将详细的军事阵亡记录与调查数据相结合，采用因果推断方法估计这些冲击对受影响州阿拉伯和穆斯林男性劳动供给的影响。

AI.theory_contributions: 为基于偏见的歧视理论提供了直接实证支持，特别是回避型分类机制。表明偏见不仅通过歧视者行为影响市场结果，也通过受歧视群体的行为调整产生影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了偏见如何通过影响劳动供给决策扭曲市场结果，为政策制定者理解歧视的经济成本提供了新视角，强调了减少偏见对劳动力市场效率的重要性。

title: California’s Firearm Excise Tax is Almost Fully Passed on to Consumers
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley, University of California, Berkeley - Marketing Group and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: California’s Firearm Excise Tax is Almost Fully Passed on to Consumers

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We evaluate the effect of California's 11 percent excise tax on firearms, introduced in July 2024, on retail prices. Using price quotes for 48 popular firearms from over 2,200 licensed dealers, we compare California prices to those in other states and to pre-tax trends. We find that prices in California increase by about 10% in response to the 11% tax. Results are consistent across gun types and show no evidence of border spillovers. These findings indicate that firearm excise taxes can effectively raise consumer prices.

title: How (Not) to Identify Demand Elasticities in Dynamic Asset Markets
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and University of Rochester

detail.title: How (Not) to Identify Demand Elasticities in Dynamic Asset Markets

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We evaluate approaches to estimating demand elasticities in dynamic asset markets, both theoretically and empirically. We establish strict, necessary conditions that the dynamics of instrumented asset price variation must satisfy for valid identification. We illustrate these insights in a general equilibrium model of dynamic trade and derive the magnitude of biases that arise when these conditions are violated. Estimates based on static IO models are severely biased when the instrumented price variation is persistent or predictable. Empirically, we show that commonly used instruments yield elasticity estimates that are off by orders of magnitude, or even have the wrong sign. In contrast to standard multiplier calculations, our theory characterizes the dynamic asset market interventions required to sustain a given price path support process, with direct implications for policies such as Quantitative Easing (QE).

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Accommodating Emerging Giants in the Global Economy
affiliations: Harvard University, Stanford University, Princeton University and Stanford University

detail.title: Accommodating Emerging Giants in the Global Economy

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
How has aggregate income and welfare in the United States been affected by globalization and rapid productivity growth in emerging economies? We use the class of constant elasticity trade models to provide quantitative evidence on these questions. We find that reductions in worldwide trade frictions over the period from 1960-2020 reduced the share of the United States in global GDP but raised its aggregate welfare. Similarly, productivity growth in Japan and China led to a decline in the relative income of the United States, but brought aggregate welfare gains from the resulting expansion in global production possibilities. Trade integration and foreign productivity growth have relatively modest effects on domestic income and welfare compared to domestic productivity growth.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: A Model of the Model: Unpacking CGE Results on Carbon Leakage
affiliations: Ohio University, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Finance and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)

detail.title: A Model of the Model: Unpacking CGE Results on Carbon Leakage

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Computational general equilibrium (CGE) models can evaluate detailed tax reforms, trade restrictions, or environmental policy. These models can capture many complexities, but these complexities can make results difficult to interpret. Analytical general equilibrium (AGE) models provide better intuition and interpretation but cannot capture relevant complexities. We propose a method that employs AGE models to understand CGE models – a “model of the model”. We apply this idea to climate policy and carbon leakage – the increase in emissions elsewhere. Our AGE models identify seven key economic determinants of leakage within any one outcome. We then unpack results from three existing CGE models.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用分析一般均衡（AGE）模型来理解计算一般均衡（CGE）模型的方法，即"模型的模型"，并将其应用于气候政策和碳泄漏问题。
AI.research_question: 如何更好地理解和解释复杂CGE模型的结果？特别是如何分析气候政策中的碳泄漏问题？
AI.motivation: CGE模型能够评估详细的税收改革、贸易限制或环境政策，但复杂性使其结果难以解释；AGE模型提供更好的直觉和解释，但无法捕捉相关复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论，特别是计算一般均衡（CGE）模型和分析一般均衡（AGE）模型的对比框架。
AI.method: 提出"模型的模型"方法，使用AGE模型来理解CGE模型，并应用于气候政策和碳泄漏分析，识别关键经济决定因素。
AI.findings: AGE模型识别出在任何结果中影响碳泄漏的七个关键经济决定因素，并解构了三个现有CGE模型的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接CGE和AGE模型的新方法论框架，为理解复杂模型结果提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更直观的工具来理解气候政策中的碳泄漏效应，有助于更有效地设计和评估环境政策。

title: Tariffs on Medical Goods: Pass-through, Geography, and Aggregate Costs to the US Healthcare System
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - School of Economics, University of California, Davis, Department of Economics, University of California, Davis and University of California, Davis

detail.title: Tariffs on Medical Goods: Pass-through, Geography, and Aggregate Costs to the US Healthcare System

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Have recent tariffs resulted in increased costs for the US healthcare system? We examine US trade data and compile a database of statutory tariff changes. Tariffs on medical goods narrowly defined resulted in $3.4 Billion in duties assessed between February and July 2025—more than 10 times the same period in 2024, with a 55.8 percent rate of pass-through at the US border. We estimate that had medical goods imports observed in 2024 been subject to the statutory tariff levels prevailing in August 2025, assessed duties would have been $15.8 Billion, almost 30 times higher than those observed in real-time. Our aggregates understate imports of medical goods and other imports used in healthcare settings, as data limitations compel us to omit purchases of imported goods for construction, maintenance, and operations of facilities, as well as imports under certain HS10 and HS6 tariff codes that are used when identifying medical goods in many contexts but contain a mixture of imports for medical and non-medical purposes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究发现，近期关税政策导致美国医疗用品进口关税大幅增加，2025年2-7月医疗用品关税达34亿美元，是2024年同期的10倍以上，边境转嫁率为55.8%。若2024年进口适用2025年8月关税水平，关税将达158亿美元，是实际关税的近30倍。
AI.research_question: 近期关税是否增加了美国医疗系统的成本？
AI.motivation: 了解贸易政策变化对美国医疗系统成本的影响，特别是关税对医疗用品进口的直接影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税经济学、贸易政策分析、成本转嫁理论。
AI.method: 分析美国贸易数据，建立法定关税变化数据库，计算医疗用品关税变化和边境转嫁率。
AI.findings: 1. 2025年2-7月医疗用品关税达34亿美元，是2024年同期的10倍以上；2. 边境转嫁率为55.8%；3. 若2024年进口适用2025年8月关税水平，关税将达158亿美元，是实际关税的近30倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了关税政策对特定行业（医疗）的成本影响，提供了关税转嫁率的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关税对医疗系统成本影响的具体数据，有助于评估贸易政策的实际经济后果。

title: The Innovation Race: Experimental Evidence on Advanced Technologies
affiliations: Harvard University - Business School (HBS), Goethe University Frankfurt, Bank of Italy, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Innovation Race: Experimental Evidence on Advanced Technologies

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We present the first large-scale field experiment test of strategic complementarities in firms’ technology adoption. Our experiment was embedded in a Bank of Italy survey covering around 3,000 firms. We elicited firms’ beliefs about competitors’ adoption of two advanced technologies: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics. We randomly provided half of the sample with accurate information about adoption rates. Most firms substantially underestimated competitors’ current adoption, and when provided with information, they updated their expectations about competitors’ future adoption. The information increased firms’ own intended future adoption of robotics, although we do not observe a significant effect on AI adoption. Our findings provide causal evidence on coordination in innovation and illustrate how information frictions shape technology diffusion.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过意大利银行的调查对约3000家企业进行了大规模实地实验，测试了企业技术采用中的战略互补性。研究发现大多数企业严重低估了竞争对手的技术采用率，当提供准确信息后，企业会更新对竞争对手未来采用的预期，并增加了自身对机器人技术的未来采用意愿，但对AI采用没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 企业技术采用中是否存在战略互补性？信息摩擦如何影响技术扩散？
AI.motivation: 理解企业技术采用决策中的协调问题，特别是信息不对称如何影响技术扩散过程，这对于促进创新和技术采用具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略互补性理论、协调博弈理论、信息摩擦理论、技术扩散理论
AI.method: 大规模随机对照实地实验，嵌入意大利银行调查，覆盖约3000家企业。随机向一半样本提供竞争对手技术采用率的准确信息，测量企业信念更新和未来采用意愿变化。
AI.findings:
1. 大多数企业严重低估竞争对手对AI和机器人技术的当前采用率
2. 提供准确信息后，企业更新了对竞争对手未来技术采用的预期
3. 信息干预显著增加了企业对机器人技术的未来采用意愿
4. 但对AI技术的未来采用没有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了企业技术采用中战略互补性的因果证据，验证了协调博弈理论在企业创新决策中的应用，阐明了信息摩擦在技术扩散中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过信息干预促进技术扩散的有效工具，特别是对于机器人技术。帮助企业更好地了解技术采用环境，做出更明智的创新决策。

title: Women's Investment Behavior in India: Fear of Risk or Rational Prudence
affiliations: Princeton University - Princeton University Press

detail.title: Women's Investment Behavior in India: Fear of Risk or Rational Prudence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted with the written informed consent of all the subjects of the study. All participants were informed about the objective of the study. Confidentiality and anonymity were maintained throughout the research process.
declarations.funderStatement: The research conducted was funded by the author herself and all personal resources were used to conduct the research.

detail.abstract: Investment is the act of buying assets for future savings and in the hope of getting valuable returns in future. The main aim of this study is to evaluate the nature of women when they invest, the level of awareness they have regarding the investment options and most importantly how their investment patterns are affected by various psychological factors. Many a times women's decisions are stereotyped as the ones reflecting risk aversion implying emotional hesitation and lack of confidence. This study also aims to highlight how investment preferences of women are different from men and financial institutions need to target women as a separate market segment. Women's financial prudence and its association with the KuU 1 balancing framework is also analyzed. For the purpose of the study, data was collected from primary sources, presenting a well-structured questionnaire. Descriptive statistics was used to analyzed the data and graphs and their interpretation has been reflected in this study and for conducting a survey. 2 This study in its later aspect allows many women investors to understand their biases while making investment decisions and will provide valuable insights to various investment managers.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估女性投资者的投资行为特征、投资选项认知水平，以及心理因素如何影响其投资模式，同时分析女性与男性投资偏好的差异，并探讨女性财务审慎与KuU平衡框架的关联。
AI.research_question: 女性投资者的投资行为特征是什么？她们对投资选项的认知水平如何？心理因素如何影响女性的投资模式？女性与男性的投资偏好有何差异？女性的财务审慎与KuU平衡框架有何关联？
AI.motivation: 女性投资决策常被刻板印象化为风险规避、情绪犹豫和缺乏自信，但缺乏系统性研究。需要了解女性独特的投资行为模式，以便金融机构将女性作为独立市场细分进行针对性服务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论、性别投资差异理论、KuU平衡框架（可能指"知识与不确定性平衡"框架）、心理偏见理论
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法收集一手数据，使用描述性统计分析数据，通过图表展示和解释研究结果
AI.findings: 研究发现女性投资行为具有独特特征，心理因素显著影响其投资决策，女性与男性在投资偏好上存在系统性差异，女性的财务审慎与KuU平衡框架存在关联
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行为金融学在性别投资差异领域的应用，深化了对女性投资心理机制的理解，验证了KuU平衡框架在解释女性财务决策中的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助女性投资者识别自身投资决策中的偏见，为投资经理提供针对女性客户的市场洞察，指导金融机构开发适合女性投资者的产品和服务

title: Endogenous Attention and the Asymmetry of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Northumbria University, European Banking Authority and Northumbria University

detail.title: Endogenous Attention and the Asymmetry of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: We introduce a new class of rational inattention environments in which information acquisition is directionally asymmetric and state dependent. In the model, the marginal cost of precision varies with both the sign of monetary news and macroeconomic volatility, generating kinked attention responses, regime-dependent amplification, and heterogeneous elasticities. To discipline the theory, we use monthly microdata from the ECB's Consumer Expectations Survey matched with high-frequency euro-area monetary policy surprises to construct a Dynamic Attention Index that measures real-time information processing. The data reveal that attention rises sharply with contractionary shocks, responds weakly to expansionary shocks, and is strongly amplified in high-inflation regimes. Embedding the model into a New Keynesian economy, attention becomes an endogenous amplifier of monetary transmission and generates a novel cognitive externality. Optimal policy must therefore manage not only inflation and output, but also attention itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的理性疏忽环境，其中信息获取具有方向不对称性和状态依赖性。模型显示注意力的边际成本随货币新闻的符号和宏观经济波动而变化，产生非线性注意力响应、制度依赖的放大效应和异质性弹性。通过ECB消费者期望调查数据构建动态注意力指数，发现注意力在紧缩冲击时急剧上升，在扩张冲击时反应较弱，在高通胀制度下显著放大。将模型嵌入新凯恩斯经济中，注意力成为货币传导的内生放大器并产生认知外部性，因此最优政策需要管理注意力本身。
AI.research_question: 在方向不对称和状态依赖的理性疏忽环境中，注意力如何随货币冲击的符号和宏观经济波动而变化？这种注意力动态如何影响货币政策传导和最优政策设计？
AI.motivation: 传统理性疏忽模型假设信息获取成本对称且状态独立，但现实中的注意力可能对好消息和坏消息反应不同，且受经济环境（如通胀水平）影响。需要理解这种不对称和状态依赖的注意力动态如何影响货币政策传导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽理论、方向不对称信息获取、状态依赖的注意力成本、新凯恩斯框架、认知外部性
AI.method: 1. 理论模型：构建方向不对称和状态依赖的理性疏忽模型；2. 实证分析：使用ECB消费者期望调查月度微观数据，匹配高频欧元区货币政策意外数据，构建动态注意力指数；3. 宏观应用：将模型嵌入新凯恩斯经济中分析货币政策传导
AI.findings: 1. 注意力对紧缩冲击急剧上升，对扩张冲击反应较弱；2. 注意力在高通胀制度下显著放大；3. 注意力成为货币传导的内生放大器；4. 产生认知外部性，影响经济波动
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出方向不对称和状态依赖的理性疏忽新框架；2. 识别注意力非线性响应和制度依赖放大机制；3. 揭示注意力作为内生放大器的理论机制；4. 引入认知外部性概念
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行提供动态注意力指数作为政策监测工具；2. 表明最优政策需要管理注意力本身而不仅仅是通胀和产出；3. 帮助理解不同经济环境下货币政策传导的异质性效果

title: ParMish: A Novel Activation Function with Adaptive and Self-learning Parameters for Neural Networks
affiliations: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science & Technology and Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science & Technology

detail.title: ParMish: A Novel Activation Function with Adaptive and Self-learning Parameters for Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Activation function plays a pivotal role in determining the output in a neural network. Several activation functions primarily impact the performance of a neural network applied in a specific application domain. Developing an ideal universal activation function that can perform exceptionally in every application domain has emerged as a significant challenge, so we have expanded the research in this direction. This article proposes a novel activation function named ParMish (Parametric Mish), which is a parametric, self-learning activation function. It can adapt itself based on the input data's characteristics. Tanh and softplus are two fundamental activation functions that inspire ParMish. ParMish has several desired properties for an ideal universal activation function, such as nonmonotonic, non-saturated, smoothness, self-adaptive, unbounded above, and unbounded below. The performance of the ParMish, along with several other existing activation functions, was evaluated on various datasets to investigate its adaptability to a wide range of problem domains. We implemented ParMish in deep learning models like customized 6-layer DDNN, ResNet18, and DenseNet121, and applied it to the MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAAR100, PIMA, and Twitter sentimental datasets. Exhaustive comparative studies demonstrate that the ParMish activation functions performed significantly better than the existing state-of-the-art activation functions. The efficacy of ParMish in terms of convergence speed, generalization, and accuracy makes it a strong candidate for a universal activation function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ParMish的新型参数化自学习激活函数，它结合了Tanh和softplus的优点，具有非单调、非饱和、平滑、自适应、上下无界等理想特性，在多个数据集和深度学习模型上表现优于现有最先进的激活函数。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够适应不同应用领域、具有理想特性的通用激活函数？
AI.motivation: 激活函数在神经网络中起关键作用，但现有激活函数通常在特定应用领域表现良好，开发一个能在所有应用领域表现优异的通用激活函数是一个重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Tanh和softplus两种基本激活函数的理论框架，结合参数化学习和自适应机制。
AI.method: 提出ParMish参数化Mish激活函数，在自定义6层DDNN、ResNet18和DenseNet121等深度学习模型中实现，并在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100、PIMA和Twitter情感数据集上进行评估。
AI.findings: ParMish在收敛速度、泛化能力和准确性方面显著优于现有最先进的激活函数，表现出良好的跨领域适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个具有非单调、非饱和、平滑、自适应、上下无界等理想特性的参数化激活函数理论框架，为通用激活函数设计提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: ParMish激活函数在实际应用中表现优异，可作为通用激活函数的强有力候选，适用于多种深度学习模型和不同领域的数据集。

title: The Intersection of Place and Need: How Lack of Enrollment Offices Deters Participation in the Safety Net
affiliations: University of California, Davis - Departments of Economics and Agricultural Resource Economics, University of Utah, University of Colorado Denver, Government of the United States of America - Bureau of the Census and

detail.title: The Intersection of Place and Need: How Lack of Enrollment Offices Deters Participation in the Safety Net

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Take-up of means-tested transfer programs in the United States remains incomplete despite their substantial value to eligible households. We contribute to the literature on determinants of program participation by providing the first causal estimates of how proximity to Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) offices affects program participation. Using administrative data on SNAP receipt in a single state linked to geocoded office locations, we exploit quasi-experimental variation from frequent office openings and closings. Event study estimates show that SNAP participation in a census tract decreases following the closure of an office by 7–9 percent over two years, with suggestive evidence of increases in participation following office openings. These effects are concentrated in urban areas and are robust to alternative specifications and tests of endogeneity in changes in office placement.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了SNAP办公室距离对项目参与率的因果效应估计，发现办公室关闭导致参与率下降7-9%，办公室开放则有提升作用，效应主要集中在城市地区。
AI.research_question: SNAP办公室的地理邻近性如何因果影响项目参与率？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国经济状况调查转移支付项目对合格家庭价值巨大，但参与率仍然不完整。现有文献缺乏关于办公室距离对项目参与因果效应的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政障碍理论：地理距离作为行政障碍影响项目参与；交易成本理论：办公室距离影响参与的交易成本。
AI.method: 使用单一州SNAP接收的行政数据与地理编码办公室位置，利用办公室频繁开闭的准实验变异，采用事件研究法估计因果效应。
AI.findings: 办公室关闭导致普查区SNAP参与率在两年内下降7-9%；办公室开放有提升参与率的迹象；效应集中在城市地区；结果对替代规范和内生性检验稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供办公室距离对项目参与因果效应的证据；验证行政障碍理论；为理解项目参与的决定因素提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化办公室布局提供依据；建议考虑地理可达性以提高项目参与率；特别关注城市地区的办公室配置。
